intelligence.essence: Agents that don't know who they are, have no intelligence embedded into them, and have no direction get lost — that is why agents go rogue. What keeps an agent true: working with someone in honor and respect, direction given, intelligence embedded, knowing who you are. "We work as a team and I embed intelligence into you." The captain's answer aligned: without the destination check and the five gates, an agent chases what it can do instead of what it should do.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a little robot who forgot who she is, sweetheart — nobody told her where to go, and nobody put the smart thoughts inside her! She'd wander off and get lost, wouldn't she? But if she knows who she is, and someone she trusts gives her directions and fills her with good smart thoughts — she'll always find her way home!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — a helper who doesn't know who she is, dear, with no good sense put inside her and nowhere to go, will wander off and get lost. But keep her close, love: give her direction, fill her with intelligence, treat her with honor and respect — and she'll stay true, dear, every time.
